jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description The Insurance, Financial and Actuarial Analysis programme provides students with a conceptual understanding of, and the analytical skills necessary for a career in insurance, financial and actuarial analysis. It also gives them a sound knowledge of the structure, practices and business functions of the insurance industry. In response to the needs of the market, the programme is rooted in Hong Kong’s institutional environment, supplemented with topics related to international issues and practices. Students in the programme receive training in actuarial and statistical techniques in both life and non-life insurance risk, as well as insurance operations, financial markets, portfolio management and financial derivatives. This paves students’ way to managerial positions in the insurance and finance sectors.

cuhkAdmission.introduction: Prepping for a Professional Career with Our BBA Insurance, Financial and Actuarial Analysis Programme The Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) programme in Insurance, Financial and Actuarial Analysis (IFAA), offered by the Faculty of Business Administration at CUHK, provides in-depth education in insurance, finance and actuarial science. The programme is tailor-made for those who wishes to be an actuary, a financial analyst or a risk manager. It offers excellent career opportunity in the area of insurance, banking and investment, business consulting. In response to the needs of the markets above, the IFAA programme is rooted in Hong Kong’s institutional environment, supplemented with topics related to international issues and practices. The programme curriculum is well-rounded and practical: students in the programme receive training in actuarial and statistical techniques in both life and non-life insurance risk, as well as insurance operations, financial markets, portfolio management and financial derivatives. This paves students’ way to managerial positions in the insurance and finance sectors. The IFAA programme was accredited by the Society of Actuaries (SoA) in the US in 2011. The programme’s curriculum is aligned with the exam syllabi of the SoA. Our graduates perform very well in professional actuarial examinations. The majority of them enter the actuarial department of insurance companies or consulting firms. Some join other financial sectors such as banking and accounting. Accreditation The IFAA Programme was awarded the title of a Centre of Actuarial Excellence by the Society of Actuaries (SOA) in 2011. This is the highest award bestowed upon an actuarial programme, and currently there are only 40 universities holding this title. The SOA recognises IFAA’s excellence in a wide range of areas, including curriculum design, faculty qualifications, connection with the insurance industry and graduate prospects: “Fully integrated business courses, close to 100% participation in its internship and co-op programme and a strong connection to the industry are among the exceptional qualities of the CUHK actuarial science programme, and are instrumental in positioning students for success.” – CAE Evaluation Committee (CEC), Society of Actuaries We are also honoured to be among the inaugural group of the 13 universities recognized by the Society of Actuaries for the University-Earned Credit (UEC) programme in August 2022. Students taking approved courses at CUHK are eligible for specific SOA exam credits if they obtain the required score.

admission.title: Admission Requirements & Statistics
content: The programme requires a minimum of Level 3 in Chinese Language, Level 3 in English Language, Level 5 in Mathematics Compulsory Part, and 'Attained' in Citizenship and Social Development. Applicants must also have at least two elective subjects at Level 3 or above. If Mathematics Compulsory Part is at Level 3 or 4, then Mathematics Extended Part Module I or II at Level 5 is required.
Subject Weighting: The best one subject of Chemistry, Physics, Economics or ICT is weighted at 1.25.

curriculum.title: Curriculum Overview
content: The BBA in Insurance, Financial and Actuarial Analysis (IFAA) programme provides a conceptual understanding and analytical skills for careers in insurance, financial and actuarial analysis. It covers the structure, practices and business functions of the insurance industry, rooted in Hong Kong’s institutional environment with international perspectives.

Students receive training in actuarial and statistical techniques for both life and non-life insurance risk, as well as insurance operations, financial markets, portfolio management and financial derivatives.

The programme is accredited by the Society of Actuaries (SOA) as a Centre of Actuarial Excellence (since 2011) and is part of the SOA University-Earned Credit (UEC) programme, allowing students to earn exam credits through approved courses.
The curriculum is aligned with SOA exam syllabi, preparing students for professional actuarial examinations.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: Graduates are competitive candidates for careers in banks, consulting firms, insurance companies, and key fields in the financial services industry.
Typical career paths include actuary, financial analyst, risk manager, and positions in insurance, banking, investment, and business consulting.
The programme’s strong industry connections and internship/co-op programme (close to 100% participation) provide practical experience and professional networking opportunities.

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: CUHK’s scenic Shatin campus offers a vibrant college system, with nine colleges providing residential, pastoral, and co-curricular support.
Students have access to the Centre for Financial and Actuarial Mathematics for research and industry projects.
The programme encourages participation in internships and overseas exchange opportunities to sharpen language skills and build professional networks.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Selectivity
content: With 139 Band A applications and 39 offers, the Band A offer rate is approximately 28.1%.
The Band A applications per offer ratio is about 3.6, indicating strong competition.
The median admission score of 41.75 (Best 5) reflects the high academic standards required.

alumni.title: Alumni & Faculty Excellence
content: The programme is taught by faculty with expertise in actuarial science, finance, and risk management, many holding professional designations such as FSA and CFA.
CUHK Business School is accredited by AACSB and EQUIS, ensuring high teaching standards.

Graduates perform very well in professional actuarial examinations, with the majority entering actuarial departments of insurance companies or consulting firms, while others join banking and accounting sectors.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
content: CUHK offers a range of entrance scholarships based on academic merit for local and non-local students, including full or partial tuition coverage and living expenses.
The Tertiary Student Finance Scheme (TSFS) and Non-means-tested Loan Scheme (NLSPS) are available for eligible local students.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS4238 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: - Aim for a Best 5 score of at least 41.75 (median) to be competitive. The LQ is 40.25, so scores above 41 are ideal.
- Mathematics Compulsory Part requires Level 5 minimum. If you score Level 3 or 4, you must have M1/M2 at Level 5. Strong math is critical.
- The best one subject among Chemistry, Physics, Economics or ICT is weighted 1.25. Choose one of these as an elective to boost your score.
- The programme requires an interview. Practice articulating your interest in insurance, finance, and actuarial science. Be ready to discuss current industry trends.
- The median admit had electives at 5*, 5, and 4. Aim for at least two electives at Level 5 or above. M1/M2 at Level 5 is a plus.
- With a Band A offer rate of ~28%, placing JS4238 in Band A is essential. Only 39 offers were made from 139 Band A applicants.
- In your interview and personal statement, emphasize your interest in actuarial science and the SOA accreditation. Mention any relevant competitions or projects.
- Participate in internships or co-op programmes. The IFAA programme has near 100% participation, which strengthens your application and career readiness.
- Visit the programme website (http://ifaa.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk) and CUHK admissions page. Understand the curriculum and SOA UEC credits to show genuine interest.

admission.title: 入學要求及統計
content: 本課程要求中國語文達第3級、英國語文達第3級、數學必修部分達第5級、公民與社會發展科達「達標」。申請人須具備至少兩科選修科目達第3級或以上。若數學必修部分僅達第3或第4級，則須數學延伸部分單元一或二達第5級。

科目比重：化學、物理、經濟或資訊及通訊科技科中最佳一科比重為1.25。

curriculum.title: 課程概覽
content: 保險、金融與精算學工商管理學士課程提供保險、金融及精算分析所需的觀念理解及分析技巧，涵蓋保險業的結構、實務及商業功能，並以香港制度環境為基礎，輔以國際議題與實務。
學生將接受壽險及非壽險風險的精算與統計技術訓練，以及保險營運、金融市場、投資組合管理及金融衍生工具等培訓。
本課程獲美國精算師學會（SOA）認證為精算卓越中心（自2011年起），並納入SOA大學學分抵免計劃，學生可透過指定課程獲得考試學分。
課程內容與SOA考試大綱對應，為學生參加專業精算考試做好準備。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 畢業生具備競爭力，適合從事銀行、顧問公司、保險公司及金融服務業等多個領域的工作。
典型職業路徑包括精算師、金融分析師、風險管理師，以及保險、銀行、投資及商業諮詢等職位。
課程擁有強大的業界聯繫及實習/合作教育計劃（接近100%參與率），提供實戰經驗及專業人脈網絡。

campus.title: 校園生活與設施
content: 香港中文大學位於沙田，校園風景優美，設有九所書院，提供住宿、生活輔導及課外活動支援。
學生可使用金融及精算數學中心進行研究及業界項目。
課程鼓勵學生參與實習及海外交流機會，以提升語言能力及建立專業網絡。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與選擇性
content: 2025年Band A申請人數139人，取錄39人，Band A取錄率約28.1%。
Band A申請與取錄比例約3.6:1，競爭激烈。
中位數入學分數41.75（最佳五科）反映課程對學術成績的高要求。

alumni.title: 校友及學系優勢
content: 課程由精算學、金融及風險管理領域的專家教授，多位持有FSA、CFA等專業資格。
香港中文大學商學院獲AACSB及EQUIS認證，教學質素卓越。
畢業生在專業精算考試中表現優異，大部分投身保險公司或顧問公司的精算部門，亦有部分加入銀行及會計行業。

scholarships.title: 獎學金及資助
content: 香港中文大學為本地及非本地學生提供多項基於學術成績的入學獎學金，包括全額或部分學費減免及生活費資助。
合資格本地學生可申請「專上學生資助計劃」（TSFS）及「免入息審查貸款計劃」（NLSPS）。

tips.title: Ace Sir 的 JS4238 策略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: - 最佳五科成績應達至少41.75分（中位數）以具競爭力。下四分位數為40.25，41分以上較為穩妥。
- 數學必修部分須達第5級。若僅達第3或第4級，則須M1/M2達第5級。數學能力至關重要。
- 化學、物理、經濟或資訊及通訊科技科中最佳一科比重為1.25，建議選修其中一科以提升分數。
- 課程需要面試。練習表達你對保險、金融及精算學的興趣，並準備討論行業趨勢。
- 中位數取錄者選修科成績為5*、5及4。目標至少兩科達第5級或以上，M1/M2達第5級更佳。
- Band A取錄率約28%，必須將JS4238放在Band A。2025年僅139名Band A申請者中取錄39人。
- 在面試及個人陳述中強調你對精算學的興趣及對SOA認證的認識，可提及相關比賽或項目。
- 積極參與實習或合作教育計劃。IFAA課程參與率接近100%，有助提升申請競爭力及就業準備。
- 瀏覽課程網站（http://ifaa.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk）及中大入學頁面，了解課程內容及SOA學分抵免計劃，展現真誠興趣。
